entries.notes: R栏官话对音ca/cu存疑，然L/H/M三栏互证"久长"（mucho tiempo）义明确

entries.en: various colors; many hues, of many colors
entries.notes: L栏dolor/color存疑，据H/M"多樣色"定为"颜色多样"义（de un dolor当为muchos colores类误读）

entries.zh: 众心不一；人心不齐（意见分歧）
entries.en: many hearts, no agreement; the multitude is not of one mind

entries.zh: 太旺；非常旺盛（兴旺过盛）
絮语繁多；多话（滔滔不绝，兼指事务纷杂）
entries.en: much talk, many words; garrulous chatter (also: affairs, business dealings)

entries.zh: 沿徹；言语绵延不断（絮谈）
entries.en: long-winded talk, much speech; extended discourse
entries.notes: H"沿徹"词义晦涩，据L与第5条同款西语释义muchas palabras拟为"絮语繁多"义

entries.zh: 长钱；钱财充裕（余钱甚多）
entries.en: much money, plenty of cash; surplus money

entries.zh: 越发、愈加增多（越……越……；自行生发）
entries.en: much more, increasingly; the more..., the more so
entries.notes: H"越自發"结构费解，据L"mucho más"与"越""發"字义拟为"愈发增多"义

entries.zh: 年久月深；年深日久（历时很久）
entries.en: over long years and months; a very long time

entries.zh: 数百万；千百万（数以百万计）
entries.en: hundreds of myriads; millions upon millions, countless
entries.notes: L栏llareu/llares存疑（当为millares"数千"），H/M"數百萬"互证明确

entries.en: ten thousand; a myriad, countless number

entries.zh: 无常；变化不定（反复无常）
entries.notes: L栏quy/quel与M栏fi/si存疑，然L"mudable"与H"無常"互证"无常"义明确

entries.zh: 变面孔；变脸色（喜怒无常、翻脸）
entries.en: to change one's countenance; now sad, now glad, moody
entries.notes: M栏fin/bin存疑，H"变面孔"与L"esté triste, esté alegre"互证"变脸色"义

entries.zh: 嶢欹；倾侧动摇（不稳而改易）
entries.en: to lean and waver, be unsteady; to change (mudar)
entries.notes: H"嶢欹"字面为高倾、倾斜，据M音giâu-guí与L"Mudar"拟为"倾侧动摇、改易"义

entries.zh: 被（人）摇动改易；受人改动（被动）
entries.en: to be changed or swayed by others (passive)
entries.notes: H"嶢被人"文义晦涩，据M音giâu-py-lâng（嶢/被/人）与L"mudar"拟为"被人改动"之被动义

entries.zh: 嶢破；摇破改易（弄破改变，义存疑）
entries.en: to alter and break (uncertain; compound reading undetermined)
entries.notes: H栏"掝/破"存疑而M音pūa近"破(phòa)"，"mudar→嶢破"语义无法定夺，释义暂拟待考

entries.en: to molt; to shed skin or change plumage
entries.notes: L栏cuer/cuerpo存疑，H"脫"与西语释义互证"蜕皮换羽"义明确

entries.en: to change, transform (oneself); to change in an instant
